description: This file defines the SerializableComplexObsHandler interface, which specifies methods for handling complex observations in OpenMRS. The interface includes methods for retrieving form fields and serializing form data related to complex concepts.

classes.name: SerializableComplexObsHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling complex observations that require serialization and form integration within OpenMRS. Implementing classes are responsible for providing form fields and serialization logic for complex concepts.

methods.name: getFormFields
methods.description: Returns a set of form fields that should be embedded in forms using complex concepts associated with this handler.

methods.name: serializeFormData
methods.description: Transforms or serializes the input data into a format suitable for transmission or storage, such as converting XML to HL7 message format.
